# Postal v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir bindings for libpostal — fast address parsing and normalization via Rust NIF

## Pages

- [Elixir Postal](https://postal.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Contributing](https://postal.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [LICENSE](https://postal.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Postal](https://postal.hexdocs.pm/Postal.md): Elixir bindings for [libpostal](https://github.com/openvenues/libpostal), a fast
statistical parser/normalizer for street addresses around the world.

- Exceptions
  - [Postal.Error](https://postal.hexdocs.pm/Postal.Error.md): Exception raised by bang variants of `Postal` functions.
